text:
sophia: Heads-up — UX spike: we want a ‘Net unit econ’ card on the cost dashboard. Show token cost - cache credits per-route + per-model. Need input on attribution and compute cost.
chris: Nice. Is this net = billed_tokens - cache_hit_tokens * cache_price? or do we amortize cache savings across routes that share caches?
ellie: Ideally amortize, otherwise routes that hit cache less look much worse. But amortization needs lineage. We have partial lineage via cache-key -> route mapping logs.
rahul: Lineage exists but noisy. We can do two modes: 1) direct (only attribute where we can prove the hit came from the route) 2) pooled (pro rata by route requests touching the same model/pool). Pooled is cheaper to compute.
sophia: UX Q — show both? Toggle: Proven vs Amortized. Product wants a single default that’s understandable for PMs.
chris: Default = Amortized (pro rata) with a tooltip explaining methodology and confidence%. Also surface sample rate so customers know how much of traffic is used for attribution.
ellie: For numbers we need a nightly aggregation pipeline. Proposed SQL to compute pooled attribution (simplified):
```sql
-- pool attribution: per-pool cache_savings split by route weight
WITH pool_hits AS (
  SELECT pool_id, sum(hit_tokens) AS pool_hit_tokens
  FROM cache_events
  WHERE ts >= '{{start}}' AND ts < '{{end}}'
  GROUP BY pool_id
), route_usage AS (
  SELECT pool_id, route_id, sum(total_tokens) AS route_tokens
  FROM requests
  WHERE ts >= '{{start}}' AND ts < '{{end}}'
  GROUP BY pool_id, route_id
)
SELECT r.route_id, r.pool_id, (r.route_tokens / sum(r.route_tokens) OVER (PARTITION BY r.pool_id)) * p.pool_hit_tokens AS attributed_hit_tokens
FROM route_usage r JOIN pool_hits p USING (pool_id);
```
rahul: That SQL is fine as a starting point. Need to bucket by model_sku too (quantization/variant differences).
sophia: Also product wants per-100k-token unit cost so PMs can compare across models. Add per-model SKU row and net cost per 100k tokens.
ellie: Warning: if we show per-tenant breakdown, we must mask small tenants or sample to avoid exposure. Suggest thresholds: min_requests=1000 in window or show as "<threshold".
chris: On telemetry load — doing this at high cardinality nightly could be heavy. Suggest a two-tier approach: compute full attribution at pool+model granularity, then roll up to route+tenant using pre-aggregated counters. That keeps storage/compute bounded.
rahul: Agree. Implementation plan: incremental daily job writes to cost_attribution table; UI reads per-route materialized rollups for the dashboard. Freshness SLA: 24h.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: cost-aggregation-job v2 deployed to prod in cluster-cost-agg (hash: b4f7a2) — 1956004400
sophia: Nice. UX follow-ups: show confidence score (percent of attributed hits vs total pool hits). Add link to raw lineage for ops. Also a quick 'what-changed' annotation when we flip attribution algorithm.
ellie: For confidence calc: confidence = attributed_hit_tokens / pool_hit_tokens. We'll emit that as a metric.
chris: One more: do we show gross token cost alongside net? Sales asks to show gross for invoices. I'd say show both side-by-side: Gross / Net / Cache credits (absolute and %).
sophia: Agreed. Also include small help copy: "Net = Gross token cost minus attributed cache savings. Method: Amortized by pool+model unless 'Proven' toggle selected."
rahul: Will add a flag in job metadata for algorithm version so past numbers are reproducible. Put algorithm_version and sample_rate in table.
ellie: I'll sketch the dashboard wireframe and add mock numbers. Will also include SQL link and a tiny timeline widget for algorithm_version changes.
chris: Estimate: infra cost for daily job ~ 0.5 vCPU-hours + 20GB scan if we optimize with partition pruning. Can we get that into infra budget?
sophia: I'll raise a small proposal with PM/Finance. Thanks all.
chris: tagging @ellie for the wireframe assets and @rahul for the job repo.
ellie: on it.
rahul: I'll open a PR for the job with versioning and sample config.
sophia: Perfect — closing thread for now, will reopen once mocks and cost ask are in. :thumbsup:
